decisions.reason: As a surviving carpet line with a dedicated page in both 2023 and 2024, it appears close enough to the firm's interior-material and design capabilities for management to keep refining rather than withdraw it.

Although a hand-knotted wool-silk carpet is more niche and somewhat less central than furniture, its continued standalone presentation suggests the firm sees enough fit with its premium materials and interior-project knowledge to retain it.

The shift from a dedicated product page in 2023 to only a brief website mention in 2024 signals weaker traction, and despite its closeness to the firm's furniture know-how management is likely to reallocate resources if learning and market response have been limited.

Its continued dedicated presence indicates acceptable performance, and as a low-pile carpet it is adjacent enough to the firm's design, materials and project-support competences to justify keeping it on the market.

A swivel shell chair line with several models sits squarely in the firm's core seating and design capabilities, giving it strong absorptive capacity to interpret feedback, improve variants and continue commercialization.
